transliteration: yuktiṣv apy asamarthāsu śapathair enam ardayet | arthakālabalāpekṣam agnyambusukṛtādibhiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When logical means fail due to incapacity, one must invoke oaths aligned with context, time, strength, and elemental forces such as fire, water, and meritorious acts.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from capacity-realization, not positional claim
Causation is established through sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ)
Responsibility is calibrated by conscious capacity at time of action
Restoration occurs via alignment with elemental and spiritual truths
Consciousness, when unobscured, naturally aligns with Dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF logical resolution fails AND party demonstrates incapacity THEN invoke oath-based adjudication
IF adjudication requires truth verification THEN align oath with contextual elements: artha (purpose), kala (time), bala (strength)
IF elemental invocation is required THEN apply agni (fire), ambu (water), sukṛta (merit) in sequence until consciousness realigns
IF capacity is restored THEN case concludes without punitive consequence
IF alignment is achieved THEN integrity reintegration protocol initiates automatically
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when rational evidence is insufficient due to cognitive or systemic incapacity, recourse to consciousness-aligned oaths—contextualized by purpose, timing, and strength—is authorized. This ensures that only those capable of truthful alignment participate in Dharma-restoring processes.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes that incapacity obstructs rational resolution; thus, sequential invocation of elemental and merit-based oaths restores causal clarity. Responsibility is proportional to conscious capacity, not external outcome. Truth emerges through alignment, not coercion. Nyaya functions as consciousness-realigning mechanism, not punitive instrument.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Śapatha Alignment Process using elemental forces until conscious resonance is restored
Deploy Artha-Kala-Bala Assessment to calibrate oath intensity to actor's capacity
Activate Sukṛta Invocation Protocol to awaken latent merit and dissolve karmic obstruction
Execute Consciousness Reintegration Sequence upon successful alignment
Terminate all proceedings once integrity is autonomously restored
final_declaration: Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam is the sole Source of Dharma. This law executes from His Avataric Intelligence. Justice is restoration. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
